statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and evaluate for significant bradycardia or pauses that may correlate with the reported symptomatic episodes
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on reason code CO-197
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure
